cargoZones.label: Boot behind third row with all 7 seats in use
cargoZones.notes: Skoda technical data publishes 340 L behind the third row for 7-seat versions, measured up to headrests with the boot cover stored under the floor. The cuboid dimensions are estimated from third-row width and depth, so soft bags will fit better than rigid cases near seatbacks and tailgate trim.

seatBackEncroachment.notes: Default rear seat-back rake assumption for optional encroachment-aware cargo planning.

cargoZones.label: Cargo area with row 2 in place and row 3 folded down
cargoZones.notes: Skoda publishes 845 L for the 7-seater with the third row folded, depending on second-row position and backrest angle. Planning dimensions are estimated and do not account for wheel arches, seat hardware, or sloping glass.

seatBackEncroachment.notes: Default rear seat-back rake assumption for optional encroachment-aware cargo planning.

cargoZones.label: Maximum cargo area with rear rows folded
cargoZones.notes: Skoda publishes 2,035 L with rear seats folded up to the roof for the 7-seat version. This is a planning envelope for two occupants plus maximum luggage, not a guarantee of rectangular rigid-item fit.

seatConfigurations.label: All 7 seats in use
seatConfigurations.notes: Rental listings often show only 1 bag when all seven seats are used; plan for compact soft bags unless passenger count is reduced.

seatConfigurations.label: Third row folded
seatConfigurations.notes: Assumes the third row is folded under the luggage-compartment floor while the second row remains available.

seatConfigurations.label: Rear rows folded
seatConfigurations.notes: For two occupants plus maximum cargo; floor flatness and cargo-cover storage depend on trim and seat setup.
